name: Turso

free_tier.notes: Sync traffic for embedded replicas/offline sync

notes: Perpetual free tier (no time limit), no credit card required per official page ("Start free today, no credit card required"). Community support only; no teams, audit logs, SSO, or compliance features on free. Turso restructured plans when it introduced the Developer plan ($4.99/mo) — free tier limits above reflect the current post-change plan. Databases can be created via API (good for per-tenant DB patterns) within the 100-database cap.
